title: Motion-DESIGNER cue sheet (one clock for picture, sound and QA)
description: Engine-neutral timing of one film, in seconds. Written by video-director/scripts/cues.py from an engine's own timing (motionmaxxing render events, cinetic out/cues.json, anidoodle cue sheet) plus PLAN.md; read by motion-critic critic_scan.py --cues.

source.description: engine and file the cues came from

hits.description: moments the sound must land on (drop, lock, logo, Enter)

breaths.description: designed silences [t0, t1]: the mix must be quiet here

holds.description: designed held frames [t0, t1] (poster, end card): must still carry visible motion if longer than 1.4 s
